generatedFrom: 2026-09-11, next 16.2.12 -> 16.3.4 for two critical unauthenticated RCE advisories (GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36, windows-hosted servers; GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4, the Image Optimization API on AVIF — this app optimizes student photos). ONE ceiling RAISED, the shared (shared) rootMainFiles, from 130400 to 136000. No product code changed in this commit: the framework's own runtime is the whole of it. Shared went 129591 -> 135164, +5573, and every route's entry JS FELL at the same time — receipts -914, defaulters -898, exports -895, admin-tools -894, payments -893, fee-setup -868, students -841, dashboard -702, transactions -700, reminders -557, lists -556 — because 16.3.4 moves code out of per-route entries into the chunk every route shares. First load per route is therefore up about 4.7 KB rather than 5.6, and the bytes that moved are now downloaded once for the whole session instead of once per route. There was nothing to cut: not one import of ours moved, and the alternative to the raise is shipping a known unauthenticated RCE against a live school's fee ledger. Headroom is 836 bytes, deliberately the same discipline the entry already had (809), so the shared chunk still cannot absorb a heavy SDK without somebody noticing. Route ceilings are left exactly where they were; each now carries 900-1600 bytes more slack than it did, which is a ratchet-down sitting there for whoever wants it and not a licence to spend. --- 2026-09-08, the reminder audience split from the template. TWO ceilings LOWERED and none raised. /protected/reminders 135000 -> 133700 (measured 132630, down 1889 from 134519) and /protected/reminders/lists 143900 -> 141400 (measured 140382). The screen gained a whole audience builder — every filter on every template, twelve preset buttons, an add-a-student search and per-row remove — and got SMALLER, because the notice picker and the filter fields moved from the client to the server. Both are links, GET forms and server actions, so neither needs a byte of client JavaScript; the twelve notice labels, isCampaignApproved, LATE_FEE_BASES and lateFeePhrase left the browser with them. The route now has 1070 bytes of headroom rather than 481, and that is deliberately tight: the rule that every download button lives on /protected/reminders/lists still holds. --- 2026-09-08, the five recovery notices. ONE ceiling LOWERED, /protected/reminders, from 136300 to 135000, with ten templates added: every per-student body moved out of the client bundle into domain/campaign-bodies.ts and the test panel's preview moved to a server action. See that entry's note. --- 2026-09-07, the reminders collection lists. ONE route ADDED, /protected/reminders/lists at 143900, and nothing raised. See that entry's note for why a new route is gated on the day it ships. /protected/reminders moved 135495 -> 135593: +98 bytes for a server-rendered ReactNode of links, because every download button, the share sheet and the copy button were deliberately put on the new route instead. --- 2026-09-04, the eighteen _v3 WhatsApp templates approved and Live. ONE ceiling raised, /protected/reminders, from 134500 to 136300; nothing else moved. See that entry's note. 2026-09-03, fee-reminder upgrade Phase 1. ONE ceiling raised, /protected/reminders, from 133300 to 134500; nothing else moved. See that entry's note for what was cut before raising it and what was tried and rejected. The rule stands: ceilings ratchet down, and a raise is a decision with a name on it rather than a number that drifted. 2026-08-21, WhatsApp reminder cadence. One ceiling raised and eight lowered. The raise needs saying out loud, because the rule here is that ceilings ratchet down. /protected/receipts was ALREADY over its ceiling at 4028da4 — 144858 against 144700 — before any of this work; the hand-off's own verification list omitted quality:bundles:check, so CI had been red on it since. Its heavy dialogs are already behind next/dynamic, so the remaining bytes would mean refactoring receipts-quick-load on a live money screen to chase a threshold. It is raised to 145200: current plus 300, deliberately the tightest headroom in the file, so it cannot absorb anything further without being noticed. Everything else is lowered to what each route actually costs plus 1000 bytes, which is stricter than the ~1.5% the previous pass left. The reminders feature itself contributes almost nothing to any route: its collapsible section lives in components/ui/collapsible-section.tsx rather than on the shared Section, because adding it there cost /protected/receipts 188 gzip bytes for a disclosure that route never renders.

measurements.note: RAISED from 126700 on 2026-09-12, and it needs saying out loud, because the rule here is that ceilings ratchet down. NO dashboard product code grew: its own page chunk is byte-identical and app/protected/layout.js SHRANK 17779 -> 16234. What happened is a webpack re-split. Adding client components to the STUDENTS routes (the mark-as-left sheet and the shared send-reminder sheet) changed the shape of the shared module graph, so code that sat in the layout chunk and in 9159/9619 was redistributed into two new shared chunks (4081, 6664). Measured per chunk: +4056 +3404 -2833 -1189 -1545 = +1893, against 1884 bytes of headroom. The route was therefore 9 bytes over before a single character of this feature's own copy was counted, and no amount of trimming dashboard prose can reach it. What WAS trimmed rather than waved through: the money glossary's write-off entries were rewritten twice and a whole term (writeOffLeftSchool) was folded back into closedAsDiscount, taking this feature's own contribution from +303 to +39; the discounts board's write-off tile is now SHORTER than the copy it replaced. 126800 is measured 126748 plus ~50 - the tightest headroom in this file by a wide margin, deliberately, so the dashboard cannot absorb anything further without somebody noticing. Previous headroom was 1884 bytes; this is a ratchet DOWN in everything except the number.

NEW on 2026-09-07 with the collection lists, and gated from day one rather than after it grew. This route exists so /protected/reminders does not have to carry downloading: DownloadAnchor, the share sheet and the copy button are all client components, and the send screen had ~800 gzip bytes of headroom. Putting them here cost that screen 98 bytes (135495 -> 135593) for one server-rendered ReactNode of links, which is the whole point of the split. An ungated route is where those components would quietly pile up instead, so it gets a ceiling like every other daily screen. Measured 143345; 143900 is ~500 above, per this file's convention.
